start.question: How do I start?
start.answer: Clone both repositories, run make dev on the backend and npm run dev on the frontend.

languages.question: How do I add a language?
languages.answer: Add it to LANGUAGES on the backend and a folder in src/locales on the frontend.

design.question: How do I change the design?
design.answer: Edit src/config/brand.ts: colours, radius and font apply to every block and component.

remove.question: How do I remove these examples?
remove.answer: Delete src/examples and its line in the routes; the blocks stay available in src/components/blocks.
